watch.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) is on IR and Carson Beck (back spasms) missed Week 11; Josh Johnson started a 34-7 loss at Kansas City. LaFleur doesn't expect Beck out long.
QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery) is on IR with a Week 16 target; Jacoby Brissett started the 35-33 loss at Carolina.
TE Dalton Kincaid and CB Christian Benford missed Week 11 and face a short week before Thanksgiving vs. Kansas City.
CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) missed the Saints game and looks unlikely for Thanksgiving at Detroit.

RG Dalton Risner (knee) and LB Oren Burks (groin, placed on IR) are ruled out for Monday at Washington; G Dylan Fairchild (oblique) and CB Dax Hill (illness, did not practice) are questionable, WR Andrei Iosivas (thumb) doubtful.
S Kyle Dugger (quad), who has missed six games, is questionable to return Monday; QB Joe Burrow (illness) practiced fully all week.
CB DaRon Bland (IR Saturday), G Tyler Booker (high-ankle sprain) and S Jalen Thompson are all out; Bland and Booker were full-time starters.
TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle) is inactive vs. Tennessee and likely out multiple weeks, per Brian Schottenheimer.
DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL and is out for the season; C Cade Mays went on IR Saturday. Our ratings still include Hutchinson's games.
S Kerby Joseph played vs. Tampa Bay for the first time this season; our ratings were built entirely without him.
Edge Micah Parsons, out since last December's ACL tear, is on track to make his 2026 debut Nov 25 at the Rams per Jay Glazer; our ratings were built without him.
The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after the 26-3 loss at Houston; Anthony Richardson starts. Both starting tackles and both top corners missed that game.
OT Walker Little (knee) and CB Jarrian Jones (chest) left the loss to the Giants, with C Robert Hainsey (knee) already out.
G Trey Smith (concussion), OT Jaylon Moore and RB Kenneth Walker III missed Week 11 and are uncertain for Thanksgiving night at Buffalo.
WR Puka Nacua went on IR Nov 12 after knee (MCL) surgery and is likely out for the season; WR Davante Adams (hamstring) also stays out, so ratings built with both overstate the Rams.
QB Justin Herbert entered the concussion protocol after the Week 11 loss to the Jets; his status for New England is in doubt, and the Chargers are 1-9.
Rookie Fernando Mendoza took over at QB after Kirk Cousins was traded to Minnesota; most of the ratings were built with Cousins.
TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) missed the Week 11 loss at Denver after leaving Week 10 at halftime; Klint Kubiak is optimistic he plays at Cleveland.
QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord started Weeks 10-11, including a 102-yard passing day in the 26-9 loss at Buffalo.
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) has missed three straight games and is week-to-week; Kirk Cousins started the 35-10 loss at San Francisco. WR Jordan Addison also sat.
QB Drake Maye fractured his right ankle in Week 10 and may miss the season; Tommy DeVito starts, but our ratings were built with Maye.
Three offensive line starters out: OT Asim Richards (weeks), OT Taliese Fuaga and C Erik McCoy.
Starting S Justin Reid was released at his request; LB Pete Werner and CB Martin Emerson Jr. are also inactive at Chicago.
QB Geno Smith (ankle) returned and threw three TDs in the 27-24 win at the Chargers; Cade Klubnik had played much of the Week 10 loss to Buffalo.
Jalen Hurts is on IR for the season; Joe Milton has made two starts. The Week 11 win over Pittsburgh ended a seven-game losing streak.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), out five of the previous six games, returned in the Week 11 win over Pittsburgh.
LB Zack Baun (back) is on IR; CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) and RB Saquon Barkley (left arm) left the Steelers game, both uncertain for Thursday at Dallas.
LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) was hurt at Philadelphia and LB Nick Herbig was inactive; G Mason McCormick and WR Michael Pittman Jr. are on IR.
WR Mike Evans (Achilles) left Week 6 early, missed the games since and returned in the 35-10 win over Minnesota; recent ratings came without him.
RT Colton McKivitz, who had played every offensive snap, broke and dislocated his left ankle vs. Minnesota and is likely done for the season.

Questionable on the final report: CB Amik Robertson (ankle, a game-time decision per Dan Quinn), RB Rachaad White (heel) and RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin, trending toward playing per Quinn); C Lucas Patrick cleared concussion protocol and will start.

2026_12_NE_LAC.summary: Drake Maye's fractured ankle puts Tommy DeVito at QB for New England, which our ratings don't see; Herbert's concussion has pulled the line from LAC -3.5 back to -1.5.

reasons.text: QB Drake Maye fractured his right ankle in the Week 10 loss in Munich and could miss the rest of the season; Tommy DeVito is expected to start.
QB Justin Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday's loss to the Jets; this pushes our way, and the line has dropped from LAC -3.5 to -1.5.
New England comes off two straight blowout losses (Lions, Packers) and a bye; the game was moved to 4:05 PM ET Nov 29.

swings.LAC: Drake Maye's fractured ankle put Tommy DeVito at QB for New England, so the market moved to the Chargers; Herbert's concussion (Nov 22) has since trimmed that (ESPN, Nov 23).

2026_12_CHI_DET.summary: Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending ACL tear moved this line from Detroit -2.5 (spring) to Chicago -2.5; that's worth about 2 of our 4-point gap.

reasons.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) is on IR for the season; C Cade Mays (ankle) went on IR Saturday, so he misses at least four games.
The early (May) line had Detroit -2.5, so the market has swung about 5 points since then.
Bears CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) missed Week 11 and looks unlikely for this game; Lions CBs D.J. Reed and Ennis Rakestraw also sat Week 11.

swings.DET: DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL and C Cade Mays went on IR; the market marked Detroit down, our ratings haven't caught up (ESPN, Nov 22).

2026_12_NYG_IND.summary: The Colts cut QB Daniel Jones after a 26-3 loss at Houston and turn to Anthony Richardson, with both tackles and both top corners hurt; our ratings see none of it.

reasons.text: Indianapolis released starting QB Daniel Jones Friday; Shane Steichen named Anthony Richardson the starter, with Riley Leonard as backup.
In Thursday's 26-3 loss at Houston the Colts played without OTs Bernhard Raimann and Jalen Travis and CBs Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward.
The line opened Giants -4.5 and is now -6.5 after the Jones release.

swings.NYG: Nothing Giants-specific beyond a 23-18 win over Jacksonville; the market moved on Indianapolis' 26-3 loss and the Daniel Jones release (ESPN, Nov 20).

2026_12_NYJ_MIA.summary: Miami is on Kyle McCord with Malik Willis on IR, while Geno Smith threw three TDs in a win at the Chargers; that explains part of the 3.5-point gap.

reasons.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord passed for 102 yards in the 26-9 Week 11 loss at Buffalo.
Jets QB Geno Smith (ankle) returned and went 17 of 21 with three TDs in the 27-24 win at the Chargers.
Wind forecast near 15 mph (gusts 19) in Miami; the line has moved from Jets -3 to -3.5.

2026_12_WAS_ARI.summary: Arizona's QB room is the likely reason: Gardner Minshew is on IR and Carson Beck (back) sat Week 11, when the Cardinals lost 34-7 at Kansas City.

reasons.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) is on IR; Carson Beck (back spasms) missed Week 11, though Mike LaFleur doesn't expect a multi-week absence.
With Josh Johnson at QB, Arizona lost 34-7 at Kansas City in Week 11, a week after a 34-6 loss to the Rams; the line moved from WAS -6 to -7.

swings.GB: Edge Micah Parsons (ACL) is targeting his season debut at the Rams on Nov 25 after practicing since early November; the market moved toward Green Bay, our ratings were built without him (Packers.com, Nov 4).

2026_12_GB_LA.summary: The market sits below us mainly because Rams WR Puka Nacua is out (likely for the season after Nov 12 knee surgery) and Packers edge Micah Parsons is expected to debut; our ratings were built with Nacua and without Parsons.

reasons.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua went on IR Nov 12 (knee MCL, turf toe), had surgery and is likely out for the season; most of our Rams ratings include him.
Packers edge Micah Parsons (ACL) is on track to make his 2026 debut at the Rams Wednesday, per Fox's Jay Glazer.
Rams WR Davante Adams (hamstring, IR since Oct 20) won't play; on Sunday's first report S Kam Curl (toe) and TE Terrance Ferguson did not practice, RB Kyren Williams was limited.

returning.text: Expected season debut Nov 25 after last December's ACL tear.
